places.name: La Grenouillère (historical site)
places.connection: The popular boating and bathing resort on the Seine where Monet and Renoir painted this work. The original structures are no longer there.

places.name: Bougival
places.connection: The town on the Seine where Monet was living in 1869, near La Grenouillère, providing the setting for this seminal period of painting.

places.name: La Grenouillère (site)
places.connection: The popular boating and bathing establishment on the Seine depicted in the painting.
